card.name: The word in before a patient group
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a drug name or phrase like "contraindicated" or "use of", where a patient group or condition is about to be named.

modes.label: Contraindicated or avoid in
modes.description: "in" after a warning phrase, introducing the population or condition.
modes.example: 5.4 Pelvic Inflammatory Disease and Endometritis Insertion of Paragard is contraindicated<< in>> the presence of known or suspected Pelvic

modes.label: Drug name then in
modes.description: "in" right after a drug name, before patients or a solution.
modes.example: Do not initiate OJJAARA<< in>> patients with an active infection.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words for people being treated, such as users, patients and customers.
card.plain: It fires on "in" when the text is about to say which patients a drug is or is not used in.
